options.name: command
options.description: The name of a valid command available in the used PowerShell. This could be something like C(Invoke-IcingaCheckCPU). The use of C(*) as a wildcard is allowed. O(command) is added to or removed from the chosen O(list) within the chosen O(endpoint).

options.name: endpoint
options.description: The endpoint the command should be added to / removed from.

options.name: list
options.description: The list the command should be added to / removed from.

options.name: purge
options.description: If O(purge=true), removes any command not specified in O(command) from O(list) within O(endpoint). If also setting O(state=absent), nothing will remain. If O(purge=false), commands in O(command) are added or removed if necessary. Existing commands stay untouched.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the REST-Api Command.
